title: CrawlTarget
description: Payload representing a URL enqueued in the URL Frontier for crawling

job_id.description: Unique identifier for the crawling job batch

url.description: The target HTTP/HTTPS URL to crawl

depth.description: Current link distance from the seed URL

max_depth.description: Maximum allowed depth for this crawling tree

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this target was enqueued
